name: inspektor
description: Alternative inspektor to the default Jazz-tools Inspektor
author: cleminso

scripts.deploy:production: pnpm --dir apps/studio run deploy:worker && pnpm --dir apps/website run deploy:worker
scripts.test: pnpm -r --filter='!inspektor-test' --workspace-concurrency=1 --if-present test && pnpm --filter inspektor-test test:root && node --test tools/oxlint/antiSlop/rules/noDirectLucideJsx.test.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --filter inspektor test:e2e && pnpm --filter inspektor.website test:e2e
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
